dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: You ever wonder what that floating THING is next to your head?

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: His name is HU-3. We went to high school together...he was a jerk.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: He also emits 3,000,000 mSv worth of radiation to anything near it. Hopefully that hat is made of lead.
